rules.title: TimeProvider for Time Operations
rules.check: All time operations MUST use injected TimeProvider instead of DateTime.UtcNow or DateTime.Now.
rules.rationale: TimeProvider enables deterministic testing of time-dependent logic without mocking static methods.

rules.title: Source-Generated JSON Serialization
rules.check: All JSON serialization MUST use source-generated JsonSerializerContext for AOT compatibility and performance.
rules.bad_example:
var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(user); // Reflection-based
var user = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<User>(json);
rules.rationale: Source generation eliminates reflection, enabling NativeAOT and improving startup/throughput.

rules.title: IExceptionHandler for Global Errors
rules.check: All ASP.NET Core applications MUST implement IExceptionHandler for centralized exception handling.
rules.rationale: IExceptionHandler provides type-safe, testable exception handling with proper DI support.

rules.title: Built-in Rate Limiting
rules.check: All public APIs MUST use built-in RateLimiter middleware with named policies.
rules.bad_example:
// No rate limiting or custom implementation
app.MapGet("/api/data", () => GetData());
rules.rationale: Built-in rate limiting provides consistent, configurable protection without third-party dependencies.

rules.title: Frozen Collections for Lookups
rules.check: Read-only lookup collections MUST use FrozenDictionary or FrozenSet for optimal performance.
rules.rationale: Frozen collections optimize for read performance with immutable, cache-friendly data structures.

rules.title: SearchValues for Multi-Value Search
rules.check: Multi-character/value searches SHOULD use SearchValues<T> for vectorized performance.
rules.rationale: SearchValues uses SIMD vectorization for significantly faster multi-value searches.

rules.title: Channels for Producer-Consumer
rules.check: Producer-consumer patterns MUST use System.Threading.Channels with bounded capacity.
rules.rationale: Channels provide thread-safe, high-performance async producer-consumer with backpressure.

rules.title: System.Diagnostics.Metrics
rules.check: Application metrics MUST use System.Diagnostics.Metrics with OpenTelemetry export.
rules.rationale: System.Diagnostics.Metrics is the standard .NET metrics API with native OpenTelemetry integration.

rules.title: NativeAOT Compatibility
rules.check: Libraries MUST be designed for NativeAOT compatibility - avoid reflection, use source generators.
rules.rationale: NativeAOT requires compile-time type information. Reflection is unavailable or limited.

rules.title: Post-Quantum Cryptography
rules.check: Long-term data protection SHOULD use post-quantum algorithms (ML-DSA) on Windows with CNG.
rules.rationale: Post-quantum algorithms protect against future quantum computer attacks on current encrypted data.

rules.title: WebAuthN and Passkeys
rules.check: New authentication systems SHOULD implement WebAuthN/passkey support for passwordless auth.
rules.rationale: WebAuthN provides phishing-resistant, passwordless authentication using hardware keys or biometrics.

rules.title: TLS 1.3 Enforcement
rules.check: All network connections MUST prefer TLS 1.3 and disable older versions where possible.
rules.bad_example:
// Allows insecure protocols
ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol = SecurityProtocolType.Tls | SecurityProtocolType.Tls11;
rules.rationale: TLS 1.3 provides improved security and performance. Older versions have known vulnerabilities.

rules.title: OpenAPI 3.1 Documentation
rules.check: APIs SHOULD generate OpenAPI 3.1 documentation with comprehensive metadata.
rules.rationale: OpenAPI 3.1 enables better tooling, client generation, and API documentation.

rules.title: IOptions Validation
rules.check: All configuration options MUST use ValidateOnStart() with data annotations or custom validation.
rules.bad_example:
builder.Services.Configure<DatabaseOptions>(config.GetSection("Database"));
// No validation - bad config discovered at runtime
rules.rationale: Startup validation fails fast on misconfiguration instead of runtime failures.

rules.title: Keyed Services
rules.check: Multiple implementations of the same interface SHOULD use keyed DI services.
rules.rationale: Keyed services provide clean, type-safe resolution of multiple implementations.

rules.title: Minimal API Validation
rules.check: Minimal API endpoints MUST use endpoint filters for input validation.
rules.rationale: Endpoint filters provide consistent, reusable validation across all endpoints.

rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No `DateTime.Now` or `DateTime.UtcNow` (use TimeProvider)

rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No reflection-based JSON serialization (use source generators)

rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No `Task.Run()` in libraries (push threading decisions to caller)

rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No `.Result` or `.Wait()` on tasks (use await)
